data.name: मनीष
data.gender_notes: मनीष is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit word ‘manas’ meaning mind and ‘ish’ meaning lord. Derived from the Rigveda, it symbolizes the intellect, knowledge, and wisdom that one can attain by connecting with their inner self and the universe. The name मनीष carries the meaning “Intellect, Knowledge, Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose मनीष usually hope their child will grow to embody intellect, knowledge, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Connecting with inner wisdom and the universe
